Affordable Housing Advisory Committee has not met since the last Regular Meeting of Council.

The Planning & Heritage Committee met on Tuesday, May 5, 2026; copies of the minutes and report is
included in your package.

The Planning Board met on Tuesday, May 5, 2026; copies of the minutes and reports are included in your
package.

For information purposes, a listing of Permit applications issued for April 2026 along with YTD has been
included in your package.

Planning & Heritage Committee:

Planning Board:

Regular Meeting of Council Page 4 of 8 April 14, 2026

 Moved by Deputy Mayor Alanna Jankov
 Seconded by Councillor Julie McCabe

 RESOLVED:
 That Council approve the proposed rezoning for the subject property addressed as 231 Brackley
 Point Road (PID# 623090) to rezone from the Institutional (I) Zone to the Business Park
 Industrial (M-3) Zone and approve an Official Plan Amendment (OPA) to place the subject
 property within the Workscapes Future Land Use designation of the Official Plan.
 CARRIED 10-0

 Moved by Deputy Mayor Alanna Jankov
 Seconded by Councillor Julie McCabe

 RESOLVED:
 That Council approve the consolidation of PID# 444679 (two parcels) and PID# 600817 (two
 parcels) addressed as 600 North River Road, subject to a final pinned survey plan.

 CARRIED 10-0

 1st READING OF THE ZONING & DEVELOPMENT BYLAW (PH-ZD.2) - To adopt Bylaw PH-ZD.2-
 109, A Bylaw to amend the Zoning & Development Bylaw, to amend Appendix "G" - Zoning Map of the
 Charlottetown Zoning and Development Bylaw from Downtown Mixed-Use Neighbourhood (DMUN)
 Zone to Downtown Main Street (DMS) Zone for the properties located on King and Dorchester

Open the source agenda/package pages before the meeting.
Record the motion wording, mover, seconder, vote, and any amendments.
Compare the outcome against official minutes when posted.
Update parcel notes, bylaw amendment status, and any appeal or implementation dates.
Review prior reading status, property references, and zoning/Official Plan implications.
Track amendments, conflicts, questions to staff, and vote outcomes.
Confirm adopted wording and direct staff follow-up where required.
Verify source package completeness, legal descriptions, PIDs, maps, and draft bylaw references.
Capture procedural changes, deferrals, amendments, and implementation instructions.
Publish minutes, update bylaw status, update maps/data, and prepare implementation records.
